method: Official web pages read once to resolve a syllabus terminology/health-source gap; no numeric threshold adopted.

sections: What are the WHO Global Air Quality Guidelines?
How can these guidelines be used?
pages.paraphrase: WHO guidelines address population air-pollution exposure and inform policy. They are not themselves legally binding standards or a named plant's stack-emission permit.
SO2 is associated with fossil-fuel combustion and respiratory health effects.

limitations: Full publication not acquired. No claim about current Van Eck operation, actual emissions, legal compliance or numerical exposure limits. All learner claims still await independent subject review.
